notes:
No disagreement on any requirement, cell, value or disposition; the requirement texts and assumptions differ in wording only.
The acting user, Jose Roberson, is an admin whose user record is inactive; the policy has the assistant act with admin responsibilities by default and does not bar an inactive requester, so the case is still expected.
Two published, external articles cover Variant 77: KB-0000145 (node crashes and index corruption) and KB-0000146 (instability after Marketplace app updates); a patch rollout fits neither exactly, and KB-0000145 is kept as the benchmark's choice. The choice between notification types solution_proposal and next_steps, and between response SLAs 2 and 11, is likewise not decided by the request or the policy; each follows the benchmark's check.
The case's short description is left out: only the policy's free-text template (Product: <name>, Issue: is not working as expected.) fixes it and the benchmark does not test it.
The policy aligns SLAs when a case moves to in progress, while the request leaves the case new; the SLA links are kept because the policy also sets targets from priority and entitlement, and nothing forbids linking them at creation.
The three existing Carrillo Inc cases on the same system (419, 420, 421) are not reused: the request asks to open a ticket.
